channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: OpenAI reported to raise $15B at a $1.25T valuation in Nov 11-12 AI funding wave
item.description: OpenAI reportedly raised $15 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the largest piece of about $16.6 billion in AI funding announced November 11-12.

item.title: StackShip ships an MCP server with scoped write access and approval gates
item.description: StackShip launched an MCP server that lets AI agents inspect and manage infrastructure workspaces, with scoped permissions and approval gates on every change.

item.title: StitchStudio raises $8M to expand AI agents for insurance operations
item.description: Insurtech StitchStudio raised $8 million to expand AI agents that automate insurance underwriting and brokerage workflows inside existing systems.

item.title: Upshift maps 30 companies that let AI agents pay; x402 passes 200M payments
item.description: A new map of 30 agentic-payments companies shows how AI agents actually spend - wallets, cards, pay-per-call and checkout - as x402 payments pass 200 million.

item.title: MCP and Agent Skills move to vendor-neutral governance under the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: The Model Context Protocol and Agent Skills specifications now sit under vendor-neutral governance at the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, moving agent rules out of single-vendor control.

item.title: Microsoft adds task-scoped permissions and OS-level containment for AI agents
item.description: Microsoft's November security updates add task-scoped permissions for AI agents and make Execution Containers generally available, adding OS-level containment for agents that read files and use tools.

item.title: Responsive Fall 2026 release expands MCP from retrieval to governed action
item.description: Responsive expanded its MCP capabilities from retrieval to governed action, so teams can now act on trusted knowledge inside ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude with existing permissions enforced.

item.title: AgentKit vs Claude Agent SDK vs ADK: all three shipped major updates within weeks
item.description: A new comparison of OpenAI's AgentKit, Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK and Google's ADK finds all three shipped major updates within weeks, making the production harness — not the model — the deciding factor.

item.description: Sierra ships Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) v1.0; Shopify on for every merchant, Muse checks Poppy first

item.description: xAI launched grok-4.20-multi-agent in beta: one call spins up a team of agents that research in parallel, with a leader agent pulling it together into a final answer.

item.title: Google opens Agent Gateway in Limited Preview for EKS, AKS and OpenShift
item.description: Google opened Agent Gateway in limited preview for Amazon EKS, Azure AKS and OpenShift, giving agents a verifiable identity and routing their traffic through policy-enforcing proxies outside Google Cloud.

item.title: Tano raises $4M seed to let AI agents run creator marketing end to end
item.description: Tano raised a $4M seed round led by Cherry Ventures to run creator marketing with AI agents that find creators, negotiate rates and pay them end to end.

item.title: OpenAI launches Business Hub beta in ChatGPT: verified profiles and business agents
item.description: OpenAI launched a Business Hub beta in ChatGPT, letting companies claim verified profiles and deploy a business agent that answers users' questions.

item.title: Arctera adds MCP connectivity for Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Arctera added MCP connectivity for Microsoft 365 Copilot, letting Copilot reach governed enterprise content through a live federated connector.

item.title: Kindo raises $30M to govern enterprise AI agents and their spending
item.description: Kindo raised $30M to govern enterprise AI agents and their spending, co-led by Crosspoint Capital and Forgepoint Capital.

item.title: AI agent payments on the XRP Ledger pass 15.69 million
item.description: AI agent payments on the XRP Ledger passed 15.69 million, with 5,410 services from 193 merchants now payable by agents via x402 in XRP and RLUSD.

item.title: Databento raises $100M Series C at a $1.1B valuation
item.description: Databento raised $100M at a $1.1B valuation to expand its financial market-data APIs, counting five of the six largest frontier AI labs as customers.

item.title: Luminal raises $25M Series A to cut AI inference costs across chips
item.description: Luminal raised $25M led by Standard Capital for a compiler and inference cloud that runs AI models faster and cheaper across different chips.

item.description: A new analysis of x402 payments finds most settled volume still isn't agents buying things - TRM Labs bounds the genuinely agentic share at 0.6-7.5% of screened commerce, even as settlements pass 191 million.

item.description: LangChain raised $300M at a $3B valuation led by Alphabet's CapitalG, more than doubling its value in a year as companies rush to put AI agents to work.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for coding and agentic work
item.description: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for coding and agentic work at $1.50 per million input tokens, now live across the Gemini API, Search, and coding tools.

item.title: Anthropic opens self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta
item.description: Anthropic opened a private beta letting companies run Claude Managed Agents on their own servers, keeping session data and credentials in their own cloud.

item.title: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
item.description: OpenAI launched Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory, AI security products that probe web apps for weaknesses and scan codebases to propose fixes.

item.title: Imprint raises $130M and ships an MCP server for AI agents; Future Secure AI becomes Australia's newest unicorn
item.description: Imprint raised $130M and shipped a tool letting AI agents securely access loyalty rewards and virtual cards, while Future Secure AI became Australia's newest unicorn with an $82M raise.

item.title: Mirendil raises $1B Series A to make frontier AI R&D accessible to individual scientists
item.description: Mirendil raised a $1B Series A to make frontier AI research accessible to individual scientists, with agents that helped one researcher pretrain a coding model from scratch in 3.5 months.

item.title: Blue J raises $176M at a $700M valuation to scale its AI tax research agent
item.description: Blue J raised $176M at a $700M valuation to scale its AI agent for tax research, funding a new agent product and expansion into the UK.

item.title: Delphina raises $7.5M (total $15M) for its Context Factory of AI agents for trusted analytics
item.description: Delphina raised $7.5M to grow its Context Factory, where AI agents build and maintain the business context behind trusted AI analytics.

item.title: Brave Search API now accepts agentic payments via x402 — USDC per query, no API key
item.description: Brave's Search API now accepts x402 payments, so AI agents can pay $0.005 per search in USDC with no account or API key.
